title: Lessons-learned search
problem: Lessons from finished projects sit in close-out documents nobody opens again. This script searches a folder of close-out notes for a word and prints the matching lines with the file they came from.

title: Report standards checker
problem: Reports reach clients with inconsistent layout, naming and accessibility. This checker reads a report's settings and lists what breaks the practice's standards, so the fixes are made before review.

title: RAID log dashboard
problem: Risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies end up scattered across notes and spreadsheets, so nobody sees the whole picture. This dashboard gathers them into one view per project, with owners and what is overdue.

title: Synthetic orders for demos
problem: Demos and training need realistic order data, and client data is never allowed. This file holds a few made-up orders with regions, products and dates, ready to drop into Excel or Power BI.

title: MVP #0: idea to one-page brief
problem: A good idea often stalls because nobody has time to write it up. This Claude skill turns a rough idea into a one-page MVP brief: the problem, who it is for, a five-minute demo and what is out of scope.
